descriptionPlain:
Who we are
Hi there 👋 We’re Ethena, compliance training that customizes itself to you. Ethena combines top-rated training content with intelligent AI that builds and adapts training to reflect your company’s unique brand, roles, policies, and risks, so it feels like your team, whether that’s hard hats or virtual meetings. From auto-assigning courses based on HRIS data to transforming your policies into interactive training in minutes, Ethena helps People, Legal, and Compliance teams launch in days (not months) and cut learner seat time by up to 60% with adaptive learning paths. Ethena supports 1M+ learners across 2,000+ organizations, with a 93% learner approval rating and 96% customer renewal rate. Over the past several years, we’ve delivered consistent, durable growth, including 120%+ net dollar retention, 95%+ gross dollar retention, and strong enterprise expansion across industries. Ethena has become a go-to compliance partner for modern, global organizations.
 
Beyond training, Ethena unifies core compliance tools, Hotline & Case Management, Policy Bot, and Phishing Simulator, into a single platform, with built-in audit trails and compliance controls teams can trust.
 
Trusted by teams at companies like Genesco, Asana, Pinterest, and Synaptics, it’s a great time to join us.
 
How we work
We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy, for customers and for each other. We care about craft, we love feedback, and we take ownership. We also embrace humor (yes, the puns are real), because doing serious work doesn’t have to feel so serious.
 
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

lists.content:
We're looking for a Business Development Representative to join our GTM Engineering & Business Development team. This is a small team that supports the whole commercial motion (sales, marketing, and expansion/customer success). We move fast, prioritize high intent leads most likely to convert, and iterate quickly. You’ll work closely with our other BDR and your manager (who is also our GTM Engineer!)

This is a phone-heavy (but not phone-only!) role. Most of your pipeline will come from outbound prospecting, and much of that from cold calls. You'll also handle a steady flow of inbound leads from people who already know who we are, and have strong leads/signals supplied from GTM Engineering.

Ethena has a loyal customer base (96% of customers renew every year) and a product line that keeps growing: compliance training, Hotline & Case Management, policy, disclosures, and Phishing Simulator. That gives you a lot to talk about with HR, Legal, and Compliance leaders. Our buyers are busy and get too many emails. The BDRs who win here pick up the phone, earn 30 seconds of attention, and turn them into a meeting.

You'll get real autonomy. You can test new talk tracks, build your own call blocks around live buying signals, and use AI-assisted workflows to research an account in minutes. We want someone who treats cold calling as a craft: you listen back to your own calls, tighten your opener, and come back sharper the next day.

We’re looking for someone who is a quick learner, a problem solver, and is a self-starter.
Jamie Dodson, Lead, GTM Engineering & Business Development

Outbound (about 60% of your time)

  • Run daily cold call blocks into target accounts. Book first meetings for our Account Executives with HR, People, Legal, and Compliance leaders.

  • Build multi-channel sequences — call, email, and LinkedIn. Tie them to real signals like job changes, competitor renewals, regulatory updates, and hiring activity.

  • Write and refine talk tracks, openers, and objection responses. Share what works so the whole team gets better.

  • Research accounts and personas before you dial, so every conversation starts with a relevant reason to talk.

  • Multi-thread into top accounts, and partner with AEs and CSMs to find new personas and expansion opportunities at existing customers.

    • Inbound (about 40% of your time)

  • Follow up on marketing-sourced leads: demo requests that don't book, Sample Training requests, MQLs, event leads, webinar attendees, and inbound email.

  • Hold yourself to a speed-to-lead standard. Call high-intent leads first.

  • Work the "didn't book" and "no-show" segments hard. They're our highest-intent leads and the most likely to go cold.

  • Qualify against our ICP, then hand off to the right AE or CSM.

  • Tell Marketing which campaigns, events, and content actually turn into pipeline.

    • Across both

  • Track your conversion from outreach to connect to meeting, find where you're losing people, and fix it (or propose fixes to the team)

  • Keep HubSpot and Salesforce accurate, so our pipeline and attribution reporting holds up.

  • Build and use AI-assisted workflows for research and first-touch drafting that save time without sounding templated.

• Proven cold calling success. You have 1–2 years in a BDR or SDR seat, you've made high-volume dials against a quota, and you can point to meetings booked from cold conversations.

  • You're comfortable with rejection and hard to rattle. You can handle an objection live, stay curious, and still ask for the meeting.

  • You coach yourself. You listen back to your calls, ask for feedback, and adjust quickly.

  • Your writing is clear, fast, and human. Your follow-up emails read like a person wrote them.

  • You know how to prioritize between a fresh demo request and your next call block.

  • Experience with tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, Salesforce, and a power dialer or similar calling platform.

  • Experience A/B testing talk tracks and messaging, and reading the results honestly.

  • Experience with AI tools for account research and copywriting.

  • A plus: experience selling to HR, Legal, or Compliance personas, or working in a regulated field.

  • A plus: experience at more than one B2B SaaS company.

lists.text: What's going to be the hardest part
lists.content:
• The phone is unforgiving. Most dials won't connect, and many conversations end quickly. You'll need the resilience to have a great conversation on call 60 as well as call 6.

  • Balancing inbound and outbound. Inbound leads need speed, and outbound needs protected focus time. You'll decide every day how to protect your call blocks without letting a hot lead sit.

  • A steep learning curve. You'll need to get up to speed fast on our products, customers, personas, and the compliance landscape so you can think on your feet. Ethena is a startup — we move fast and are very busy! We’ll onboard you, but much of your learning in this area will be self-directed,

  • Cutting through the noise. Our buyers are busy and get too much outreach, so you'll need to show us you can earn attention.

lists.content:
At Ethena, we’re an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our product and engineering teams ship fast—really fast. Build cycles are shrinking, product offerings are expanding, and our roadmap evolves to meet the needs of a changing workplace.

That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a Head of Product Marketing to serve as the vital bridge between our Product team and the rest of the world. Reporting directly to our Chief Technology Officer, you will be the chief storyteller, positioning strategist, and launch maestro for everything we build. Our buyers are compliance, HR, and legal leaders. Your job is to turn what we build into a story they get in seconds. You’ll spend real time with those buyers every week, on demo calls, in customer conversations, and on webinars. Then you’ll bring what you hear straight back to the Product team so it shapes what we build next.

You aren't just here to manage project boards or oversee strategy from a distance—you’re a hands-on builder who gets excited about translating complex product features into simple, buyer-first, value-driven narratives, crisp pricing strategies, and customer-facing launch campaigns.

1. Own Positioning, Messaging & Packaging

  • Define the ICP & Value Props: Deeply understand our buyer personas across our product lines, shaping how we articulate our value to prospects and existing clients alike. That means knowing what keeps a compliance leader up at night, how they describe their own problems, and how much technical detail they actually want (usually less than you’d think). You’ll build that understanding firsthand, from the calls you’re on.

  • Master Pricing & Packaging: Partner with leadership to evaluate and optimize pricing models and product tiers as our platform grows.

  • Tell the "Why": Go beyond the "what" and "when" of releases. You will articulate why we built a feature, how it solves real customer pain points, and why it matters in the market. Every story starts with the buyer’s problem, how they work today, and the outcome they get before it gets to how the feature works.

    • 3. Be on the frontlines with buyers

  • Help drive exceptional sales calls: Join demo and discovery calls to help showcase our latest features and upcoming product launches. You'll create working prototypes to make upcoming releases come to life for buyers even before they're live. 

  • Partner on Customer-Facing Marketing initiatives: Host product webinars, showcase new features, and collaborate closely with our Customer Marketing Manager (CMM) on post-sale expansion strategies. 

    • 3. Act as the connective tissue between Product and GTM

  • Share learnings with Product: Capture what lands on demo calls, what confuses buyers, which objections keep coming up, and what they ask for that we don’t have yet. You'll synthesize and share these learnings with the Product team to help shape the roadmap and positioning.

  • Decode the Roadmap: Proactively dig into upcoming features, unearthing the underlying strategy so you can build impactful launch plans well before code hits production. Then translate it into concise, easy-to-understand language for buyers and internal teams who’ll never read a technical spec.

    • 4. Drive Launches & Hands-On Execution

  • End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead launch orchestration across Product, Marketing, Sales, CS, and Support so internal teams and external customers are aligned and hyped.

  • Create the Artifacts: Roll up your sleeves to create pitch decks, one-sheets, product web pages, explainer videos, and outbound messaging templates. Leverage AI tools or do a bit of "vibe coding" to prototype web pages, interactive tools, or automated workflows on the fly. Every asset looks and sounds polished: good lighting, clean audio, tight edits.

  • Enable the Commercial Team: Run enablement sessions, record Loom walkthroughs, and write Slack launch updates that Sales and CS can absorb in two minutes and repeat to a customer with confidence.

• Exceptional, Concise Communicator: You get to the point. Whether it’s a five-minute Loom, a Slack update, a live webinar, or an answer to a tough question, you’re clear, structured, and brief. You read your audience and pitch the message at their level.

  • Customer-Obsessed: You’d rather hear it from a customer than read it in a report. You’re energized by live calls, comfortable presenting to buyers, and quick to spot patterns across conversations.
  • Experience Marketing to Non-Technical Buyers: You’ve marketed to business buyers (compliance, HR, legal, finance, or similar) who need you to bring the story up to their level. If most of your background is with technical buyers like IT, security, or developers, show us how you’ve adapted for a non-technical audience.
  • Proven SaaS Product Marketing Background: You’ve taken complex B2B SaaS products and features to market successfully by making them simple for the people buying them.

  • AI-Forward Mindset & 'Vibe Coding' Aptitude: You natively incorporate AI into your workflow to scale your speed and output. Whether it’s using AI for messaging variations, building automation workflows, or 'vibe coding' quick landing page prototypes, mini-apps, or interactive assets, you love experimenting with technology to get things done faster.

  • Scrappy, High-Velocity Execution: You thrive in fast-paced, high-build environments where roadmaps shift rapidly. Ambiguity doesn't freeze you; it energizes you.

  • Sense of Humor & Curiosity: Startup life moves fast, and we take our work seriously, but not ourselves. A great sense of humor is a must.

Ethena combines top-rated training content with intelligent AI that builds and adapts training to reflect your company’s unique brand, roles, policies, and risks, so it feels like your team, whether that’s hard hats or virtual meetings. From auto-assigning courses based on HRIS data to transforming your policies into interactive training in minutes, Ethena helps People, Legal, and Compliance teams launch in days (not months) and cut learner seat time by up to 60% with adaptive learning paths. Ethena has become a go-to compliance partner for modern, global organizations.
 
Beyond training, Ethena unifies core compliance tools, Hotline & Case Management, Policy Bot, and Phishing Simulator, into a single platform, with built-in audit trails and compliance controls teams can trust.
 
Trusted by teams at companies like Genesco, Asana, Pinterest, and Synaptics, it’s a great time to join us.

lists.content:
At Ethena, we're an AI platform that's revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our product and engineering teams ship fast—really fast. Build cycles are shrinking, product offerings are expanding, and our roadmap evolves to meet the needs of a changing workplace.

That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Sales Engineer to serve as the critical technical partner to our revenue teams and prospective customers. You'll report into an experienced Sales Engineering Manager who has built SE functions from the ground up. You'll bring Ethena's platform to life by connecting our constantly evolving technology, AI features, and integrations directly to the business outcomes our clients care about.

This is a role for someone who's already run the presales motion and is ready to own the technical thread of a deal end to end. You should be comfortable partnering with AEs, leading technical discovery, delivering tailored demos, handling technical questions and objections, and supporting POCs and evaluations without needing to learn the fundamentals from scratch.

Most importantly, we're looking for a career technical problem-solver: someone who thrives as an individual contributor in a hands-off, high-autonomy environment, loves messing around with tech to creatively solve complex customer challenges, create cool prototypes, and tackle diverse projects beyond standard sales calls, and wants to continuously hone their technical craft, help us win deals, and expand their impact and pursue career growth as an individual contributor rather than move into people management.

• A Product That’s Actually Fun to Demo: You won't be demoing clunky 90s software. Ethena’s product is modern, fast-moving, AI-infused, and constantly improving.

  • Scope Beyond the Demo: You’ll get to own projects outside standard RFPs—building sales enablement, testing out vibe coding ideas, building interactive proofs-of-concept, and crafting technical narratives.

  • High-Trust, Collaborative Culture: No micromanagement or step-by-step handholding here. You get the space to take initiative, paired with supportive coaching when you need it.

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leadership to help shape our technical go-to-market strategy.

1. Drive Technical Sales & Tailored Demos

  • Independently own the technical thread of sales opportunities from discovery and demo strategy through technical evaluation, objections, and close, in partnership with the AE.

  • Partner with Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) during discovery and demo stages to map Ethena's technical strengths to customer pain points.

  • Maintain and refine our demo environment, ensuring it showcases our newest AI features, customization capabilities, and real-world client configurations.

  • Translate product specs, compliance workflows, and technical details into engaging, simple language for HR, IT, Security, and Legal buyers.

    • 2. Build, Prototype & "Vibe Code"

  • Build custom walkthroughs, integrations, and tailored proofs-of-concept for high-priority deals.

  • Bring a hands-on technical curiosity to the team—whether that’s experimenting with APIs, testing automated demo setups, or vibe coding custom tools to help win deals.

    • 3. Handle Technical Due Diligence & Enablement

  • Field technical and implementation questions covering data security, SSO, and HRIS integrations.

  • Own responses for RFPs, security reviews, and technical questionnaires with speed and clarity.

  • Create and maintain sales-ready assets like talk tracks, video walkthroughs/Looms, and objection-handling guides to level up the broader team.

  • Act as the feedback loop between the field and our Product/Engineering teams.

• Background Fit: Hands-on Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or presales experience supporting B2B SaaS sales cycles—or equivalent experience from an adjacent role like Implementation, Technical Solutions, or Technical CS at a SaaS startup. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you should have already run technical discovery and delivered tailored demos inside live deals, not just after the sale.

  • Technical Curiosity: You love messing around with software, APIs, integrations (HRIS, LMS, SSO), and AI tools. You get excited about "vibe coding" quick scripts or prototypes to solve a problem.

  • High EQ & Adaptability: You are easy to work with, calm under pressure, and unflappable when plans shift last minute. You hold feedback lightly, take tough notes constructively, and don't get defensive.

  • Self-Starter & High Initiative: You don't wait to be told what to do or need step-by-step instructions. You proactively look for gaps, surface solutions, and take ownership.

  • Startup Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced environments where polish takes a backseat to clarity, fast execution, and rapid iteration.

  • IC Trajectory Focus: You are energized by mastering the craft of Sales Engineering, solving customer problems, and deepening your technical mastery.

  • Environmental Familiarity: You have experience in a startup, growth-stage SaaS company, or similarly fast-moving environment where priorities shift quickly and there aren't always established processes or specialist resources to lean on.

lists.text: The Hardest Part of the Role
lists.content: Our product moves fast, and our roadmap evolves continuously. The hardest part of this job is staying ahead of a rapidly innovating platform and translating those technical changes on the fly into crisp, high-impact customer narratives. If last-minute roadmap shifts excite you rather than stress you out, you’re going to love it here.
